description: Parsed SEC EDGAR insider transactions (Form 4: who bought/sold, shares, price, net open-market value) by ticker, or an institution's latest 13F top holdings by CIK. Free public source, $0.02. Pay-per-call via x402 (USDC, Base).

_payment.description: Optional base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE payload. Omit to receive payment requirements.

cik.description: SEC CIK (required for mode=13f: the institution's CIK)

limit.description: insider: max Form 4 filings to parse (1-10); 13f: max holdings (1-50). Default 10

ticker.description: US equity ticker for mode=insider, e.g. AAPL

name: agentbit.sec_insider_13f
title: SEC Insider Trades & 13F Holdings
